Message:
ALSA: hda - add dock support for Thinkpad T431s

Add a model/fixup string "lenovo-dock", for Thinkpad T431s, to allow sound in docking station.

Tested on Lenovo T431s with ThinkPad Mini Dock Plus Series 3
